notes:
**Players arrange what they may edit, a document changes its type, two may be more than one thing to each other.**

- **Relations:** a graph sets, adds and removes one relation between two — the others between them stay. The side bar shows each with its own roles.
- **Several parents:** a parent property may hold several documents (`multiple parent`). `parent` in an access rule lets in whoever is assigned to any of them, and follows when one is added or taken out.
- **Another type:** in a document's side bar — an NPC becomes a backstory NPC, an item a homebrew one. Its text and the values both types have stay.
- **Sections for editors:** whoever may edit a document sets its sections' title, heading, style, place, folding and order — for that document alone.
- **The code:** sections in the order they are read, bracketed, moved with ▲▼; a section is no longer taken away by mistake.
- **Access of a property:** a property with access of its own is changed by whom it lets in, from a list too — the template lets players write an item's owners and where it was found.
- **Shutting oneself out** of who sees or changes something asks first.
- **Making a document** happens once, however often one clicks; the new page says Loading until it is there.
- The outline's search empties with ✕; the code's arrows are larger; the opening fox no longer starts over; the world open last is kept while another opens.
- Update the server and every app: the server keeps the new looks, orders and types.
